literal.prompt: У какой системы Sega были и версия со встроенным SEGA-CD, и отдельная портативная модель NOMAD с цветным ЖК-экраном?

literalGroups.primaryGround: The official Genesis section directly links two specific derivatives to the same platform: a GENESIS CDX with integrated SEGA-CD and the color-LCD portable NOMAD (L162-L168). This tests that paired hardware relationship rather than the conventional regional alias. All options are real Sega hardware names; Saturn and Master System are distinct systems, while Nomad is the portable derivative, leaving Genesis as the unique parent platform.
literalGroups.locator: Mega Drive page L162-L168; Saturn page L103-L110; Master System page L161-L173

literalGroups.literal: Ответ — Genesis. Sega выпускала GENESIS CDX со встроенной SEGA-CD и портативную NOMAD с цветным ЖК-экраном.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Sega explicitly describes GENESIS CDX with integrated SEGA-CD and NOMAD as portable color-LCD Genesis hardware (L168). Two short sentences name the key and explain both clues without adding an unsupported release date.

literalGroups.literal: Saturn стала шестой домашней консолью Sega и названа в честь шестой планеты.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Sega says Saturn was its sixth home TV game system and was named after the sixth planet (L108).

literalGroups.literal: Nomad — портативная версия Genesis с цветным ЖК-экраном; в Японии её не выпускали.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Sega explicitly calls NOMAD a portable Genesis with color LCD (L168).

literalGroups.literal: Sega не выпускала в Японии ни GENESIS CDX, ни NOMAD.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Sega states GENESIS CDX and NOMAD were not released in Japan (L168). This adds a verified own-platform detail beyond prompt/key.

literalGroups.literal: За рубежом Master System продавалась как MASTER SYSTEM / Power Base — переработанная версия Mark III.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Sega identifies overseas MASTER SYSTEM / Power Base as a design-modified Sega Mark III and lists differences from the Japanese version (L161-L173).
